description: VMP api-node — Deno Deploy via linked GitHub repository; Postgres via DATABASE_URL.
notes: Deno Deploy builds from the linked repo on every push (PR previews and production on main). packages/api-node/deno.json keeps deploy.org/app (+ @vmp/storage source maps, and npm: maps for @aws-sdk/* / @smithy/* so `deno cache` can resolve storage sources). Workspace-root deno.json owns nodeModulesDir (package-level nodeModulesDir is rejected). Dashboard install/build/runtime remain authoritative for the Node esbuild path. Bundle via scripts/build.mjs (createRequire banner for AWS SDK ESM, workspace aliases). Optional lean installer: node scripts/deno-deploy-install.mjs. PR gate: npm run verify:api-node. Deploy gate: Deno Deploy build status — check console.deno.com logs if red.
